# everpure_azure_recoverable_volume_groups (Data Source)

Lists the soft-deleted (destroyed, not yet eradicated) Volume Groups on a Storage Pool. A volume group appears here instead of in the [`everpure_azure_volume_groups` data source](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure/latest/docs/data-sources/azure_volume_groups) once it has been soft-deleted; several entries can share the same `soft_deletion.previous_name` when a volume group has been recreated and deleted again under the same name.

To recover one, create an [`everpure_azure_volume_group` resource](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure/latest/docs/resources/azure_volume_group) with `source_type = "recoverableVolumeGroup"` and `source_recoverable_volume_group_id` set to its `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    everpure = {
      source = "PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure"
    }
  }
}

provider "everpure" {
  subscription_id = var.subscription_id
}

variable "subscription_id" {
  type = string
}

data "everpure_azure_storage_pool" "example" {
  name                = "pool-prod-east"
  resource_group_name = "rg-storage-prod"
}

# Lists every soft-deleted (destroyed, not yet eradicated) volume group on the pool
# above.
data "everpure_azure_recoverable_volume_groups" "example" {
  storage_pool_id = data.everpure_azure_storage_pool.example.id
}

locals {
  # Every soft-deleted volume group that was named "vg-prod-east", oldest first: the list
  # is sorted by id, and a soft-deleted volume group's name (the last segment of its id)
  # is its previous name suffixed with the timestamp it was destroyed at.
  deleted_vg_prod_east = [
    for rvg in data.everpure_azure_recoverable_volume_groups.example.recoverable_volume_groups :
    rvg if rvg.soft_deletion.previous_name == "vg-prod-east"
  ]
  newest_deleted_vg_prod_east_id = (
    length(local.deleted_vg_prod_east) > 0
    ? local.deleted_vg_prod_east[length(local.deleted_vg_prod_east) - 1].id
    : null
  )
}

# Recovers the most recently soft-deleted "vg-prod-east".
resource "everpure_azure_volume_group" "recovered" {
  name                               = "vg-prod-east"
  storage_pool_id                    = data.everpure_azure_storage_pool.example.id
  source_type                        = "recoverableVolumeGroup"
  source_recoverable_volume_group_id = local.newest_deleted_vg_prod_east_id

  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition     = local.newest_deleted_vg_prod_east_id != null
      error_message = "No soft-deleted volume group previously named \"vg-prod-east\" was found on the storage pool."
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `storage_pool_id` (String) Full Azure Resource Manager ID of the Storage Pool to list recoverable volume groups on. Must be in the provider's own `subscription_id`.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `recoverable_volume_groups` (Attributes List) The recoverable volume groups found, sorted by `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recoverable_volume_groups))

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) Defaults to 5 minutes. A duration string: a number with a unit suffix s (seconds), m (minutes) or h (hours); segments can be combined, e.g. "30m" or "1h30m". Used when reading the recoverable volume groups.


<a id="nestedatt--recoverable_volume_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recoverable_volume_groups`

Read-Only:

- `bandwidth_limit_in_mbps` (Number) Bandwidth limit the volume group had, in megabytes per second (MB/s). Null when unlimited.
- `id` (String) The full Azure Resource Manager ID of the recoverable volume group.
- `iops_limit` (Number) I/O operations per second (IOPS) limit the volume group had. Null when unlimited.
- `name` (String) The timestamped name this recoverable volume group was renamed to on soft delete.
- `snapshot_protection_policy` (Attributes List) The volume group's snapshot schedule, at the time it was destroyed. Null when no schedule was set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recoverable_volume_groups--snapshot_protection_policy))
- `soft_deletion` (Attributes) Soft-delete state, present only when this volume group is soft-deleted (destroyed, not yet eradicated). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recoverable_volume_groups--soft_deletion))
- `storage_pool_id` (String) Full Azure Resource Manager ID of the Storage Pool this recoverable volume group lives on.

<a id="nestedatt--recoverable_volume_groups--snapshot_protection_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recoverable_volume_groups.snapshot_protection_policy`

Read-Only:

- `frequency` (String) How often a snapshot was taken, as an ISO 8601 duration using days or smaller units.
- `retention` (String) How long snapshots taken by this schedule were kept, as an ISO 8601 duration using days or smaller units.


<a id="nestedatt--recoverable_volume_groups--soft_deletion"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recoverable_volume_groups.soft_deletion`

Read-Only:

- `destroyed_at` (String) When it was destroyed, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `eradication_timestamp` (String) Approximate time at which the object will be eradicated automatically, as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Derived from the remaining retention when read, so it can change by seconds to minutes between reads; do not use it for exact comparisons or as an input to other resources. Use `destroyed_at` as the stable reference.
- `previous_name` (String) The name this volume group had before it was destroyed.
